title: The Life Divine
author: Sri Aurobindo
description: Sri Aurobindo develops a philosophical account of spirit, matter and the evolution of consciousness. The work considers how human life might participate in a fuller manifestation of the divine rather than retreat from the world.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
